column1: # Input fields (JDK 21.0.2 sun.lwawt.macosx.CPlatformResponder.handleKeyEvent): the VK comes from the first
# UTF-16 unit of NSEvent.charactersIgnoringModifiers (CHAR_UNDEFINED 0xFFFF when empty); the event is a dead
# key when NSEvent.characters is empty (not nil); a dead key whose layout character is not in DEAD drops the
# event (no KEY_PRESSED/KEY_RELEASED). Order: DEAD (dead key only), letter, decimal digit, keyTable by kVK.
# RULE LETTER: NSCharacterSet.letterCharacterSet; tolower() -- ASSUMED C locale (ASCII only): the real fold
#   depends on the JVM launch environment (LANG; a UTF-8 locale folds non-ASCII too); a..z -> VK_A + offset,
# RULE DIGIT: NSCharacterSet.decimalDigitCharacterSet, ch - '0' in 0..9; NUMPAD when NSNumericPadKeyMask
#   (1<<21) is set and 81 < kVK < 93 -> VK_NUMPAD0 + offset, location NUMPAD; else VK_0 + offset, STANDARD.
# MODIFIER rows in table order: first row whose mask changed (previous flags XOR flags) wins; location LEFT/RIGHT
#   by kVK, else STANDARD, except Alternate, which then continues with VK_ALT/STANDARD/KEY_PRESSED kept;
#   phase PRESSED when the mask is set in the new flags, else RELEASED.
# columns: LOCATION kVK postsTyped location | DEAD unicode VK-name VK-code | MODIFIER mask-name mask left right VK-name VK-code | RULE name values
